name: load-old
js: (()=>{const m=GTHATemplates.gtha(); const keep=['finch','north_york_centre','sheppard_yonge']; for(const s of Object.values(m.stations)){ if(!keep.includes(s.id)){delete s.lat;delete s.lon;} } m.stations.union.id='union'; const r=m.stations.kipling; delete m.stations.kipling; r.id='oldkip'; m.stations.oldkip=r; for(const l of m.lines) l.path=l.path.map(x=>x==='kipling'?'oldkip':x); const ok=GMMC.loadText(JSON.stringify(m)); return [ok, Object.keys(m.stations).length]; })()

name: geo
js: (()=>{ const s=GMMC.getMap().stations; const pick=['union','kipling','oldkip','finch','kennedy','oshawa','pearson_airport']; return pick.filter(k=>s[k]).map(k=>[k, s[k].lat&&s[k].lat.toFixed(3), s[k].lon&&s[k].lon.toFixed(3)]); })()

name: custom-fallback
js: (()=>{const m=GTHATemplates.gtha(); const u=m.stations.union; m.stations.mine={id:'mine',name:'My Stop',x:u.x,y:u.y}; GMMC.loadText(JSON.stringify(m)); const g=GMMC.stGeo(GMMC.getMap().stations.mine); const ll=GMMC.gridToLatLon(g); return [ll.lat.toFixed(4), ll.lon.toFixed(4)]; })()

name: geo-layout
js: (()=>{GMMC.loadText(JSON.stringify((()=>{const m=GTHATemplates.gtha(); for(const s of Object.values(m.stations)){delete s.lat;delete s.lon;} return m;})())); GMMC.setLayout('geographic'); return GMMC.getMap().stations.oshawa.lat; })()
